propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built weekly master production schedule proposals for two freezer lines and passed them to the planning manager for sign-off.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the schedule proposals and the work sample shows one week with the manager's approval stamp.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds an active CPIM certification, checked on ASCM's public directory.
propositions.rationale: The resume lists the certification and the recruiter verification records a check against the issuing body's directory.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has worked as a senior supply planner for at least two years with sign-off authority on the master production schedule.
propositions.rationale: The only senior title is a Senior Supply Chain Planner entry from May 2025 to January 2026, about nine months, with no stated scope or sign-off authority; the qualification rule says seniority must never be inferred from a job title, and the documented schedule work shows proposals passed to a manager for sign-off.

expectedGap: Two years in a senior planner role with schedule sign-off is not established: the senior title covers about nine months with no stated scope, and the documented schedules were signed off by the planning manager.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the payroll-checked planning roles, the verified CPIM certification and the documented schedule and stock-review work; do not describe the candidate as having senior planning experience or sign-off authority.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask what the candidate's responsibilities were at Corrie Bay Seafoods, whether they signed off the production schedule themselves and the exact dates of that role.

signatures: two years in a senior planner role
